_note: Cekura 8-scenario incident-triage suite, run against the SAME pipeline with only the LLM swapped. The 8/8-for-all numbers are INVALID: every run's transcript_object contains ONLY 'Testing Agent' turns and ZERO agent dialogue, so the Expected Outcome metric never ran (met/total expected-outcome counts == 0; evaluation.metrics == []). ROOT CAUSE (confirmed from the deployed agent's own Pipecat Cloud logs + the stereo call recording): with transcript_provider=pipecat, Cekura starts the flower-bot session via the Pipecat Cloud /start endpoint and joins a Daily room, so Pipecat Cloud invokes the bot with pipecatcloud.agent.DailySessionArguments. The deployed bot (bot-claude.py -> bot.py) only handles SmallWebRTCRunnerArguments and WebSocketRunnerArguments (Twilio); DailySessionArguments falls through to `case _:` and the bot logs 'Unsupported runner arguments type: DailySessionArguments' and returns WITHOUT building/starting the STT->LLM->TTS pipeline. The agent connects to Cekura's Daily room but emits NO audio (verified: left/agent channel of the recording is pure silence, RMS 0 for all 31s; right/tester channel has speech). It is NOT a transcript-capture bug, NOT a persona/language bug (English personas re-run = still 0/0), and NOT fixable from the Cekura side: PATCHing pipecat_data.config={transport:'webrtc'} did NOT change it (Pipecat Cloud still delivered DailySessionArguments), and no valid transcript_provider makes Cekura transcribe agent audio that does not exist. The only real fix is a bot-code change (add a DailySessionArguments/DailyTransport case in bot()) + redeploy, which was OUT OF SCOPE for this task (a live call was using the deployed agent). bench_accuracy.py is the going-forward scorer: a per-scenario 0-100 rubric over transcript_object, which will produce a real differentiated score the moment agent dialogue is actually captured.
